author: Tony Doyle
content: These guys are exceptional. I conducted a broad search for Solar  PV - 18 panels, 8kW hybrid inverter, 19.2 kWh battery storage - supply and installation services. As we're based in Glossop I contacted several companies, large and small from Greater Manchester and South Yorkshire. Ashley (owner) was first class from the outset and was by far the most helpful pre-sales, and also competed on price with all other offers. I felt comfortable with him due to the conversations we had, whereby he answered literally every question I had, on multiple phone calls, email and whatsapp exchanges and we agreed pricing and contracted within 2-3 weeks from start. Ashley and his team (Conor and Tom, very capable professionals too) then liased with the roofers who were working on a complete re-roof at my home. This was critical as I wanted the solar panels installed at the correct sequence alongside the roofing project, whereby all parties could benefit from the scaffolding in situ for re-roof. They collaborated perfectly as I'd asked them to. Super polite and professional team throughout, working as a team. Final step was the walk-thru to make sure I understood every element of the system installed and knew how to operate it via the AlphaESS mobile app. Super happy with Renegade Electrical Ltd, and will 100% recommend to family and friends, and strangers on here :) Huge thanks Ashley, Conor, Tom!
